create_logger_for_tensorboard_and_jsonl: create a Logger instance to log metrics to TensorBoard and a JSONL file with optional W&B support
use_stopwatch_timer_for_profiling: use StopWatchTimer to time a code block with the ability to pause and resume elapsed tracking
use_multistopwatch_timer_for_stages: use MultiStopWatchTimer to track elapsed time across multiple named stages that run sequentially
flatten_nested_dict_with_slash_keys: use flatten_dict to recursively flatten a nested dictionary into a single-level dict with slash-separated keys
sanitize_tensors_in_nested_structures: use recursive_tensor_item to convert all PyTorch tensors in nested dicts, lists, and tuples to plain floats
